description: Minimal horizon logo with hand-shaped asymmetric tapered orange arc and organic baseline.
usage_rules: Read this manifest before using assets.
Use SVG masters for scalable production.
Use PNG for raster assets with transparency; JPG is flattened.
Preserve the intentionally imperfect tapered arc and uneven baseline; do not replace them with a perfect semicircle or uniform stroke.
Do not add cloud clip-art, glow, 3D, shadows, textures, or taglines.
Use dark variant on Ink and light variant on white.
SVG wordmark uses Inter/Arial fallback; outline text in a vector editor after confirming font.
